description: This file defines a templated C++ class WSEndpoint within the WebSockets namespace, which manages WebSocket server endpoints. It declares methods for sending messages, handling connections, and managing event loops, with various template parameters for role, messaging, ping-pong mechanisms, and encryption.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket server endpoints with support for various roles, messaging, ping-pong keepalive, and encryption features.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection pointer associated with a handler.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a message.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Callback invoked when a connection is opened.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Callback invoked when a connection fails.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Callback invoked when a connection is closed.
